verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אָהַ֞ב נָשִׁ֧ים נָכְרִיּ֛וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְאֶת־ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה מוֹאֲבִיּ֤וֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת֙ אֲדֹ֣מִיֹּ֔ת צֵדְנִיֹּ֖ת חִתִּיֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh ’ā·haḇ nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ rab·bō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- baṯ- par·‘ōh mō·w·’ă·ḇî·yō·wṯ ‘am·mo·nî·yō·wṯ ’ă·ḏō·mî·yōṯ ṣê·ḏə·nî·yōṯ ḥit·tî·yōṯ
verses.literal: King Solomon, however loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh women of Moab Ammon Edom and Sidon as well as Hittite women
verses.literalPt: E O REI Salomão amou muitas mulheres estrangeiras, além da filha de Faraó: moabitas, amonitas, edomitas, sidônias e hetéias,

verses.original: מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר־ יְהוָה֩ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־ תָבֹ֣אוּ בָהֶ֗ם וְהֵם֙ לֹא־ יָבֹ֣אוּ בָכֶ֔ם אָכֵן֙ יַטּ֣וּ אֶת־ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם בָּהֶ֛ם דָּבַ֥ק שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְאַהֲבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: min- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ’ā·mar- Yah·weh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lō- ṯā·ḇō·’ū ḇā·hem wə·hêm lō- yā·ḇō·’ū ḇā·ḵem ’ā·ḵên yaṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem bā·hem dā·ḇaq šə·lō·mōh lə·’a·hă·ḇāh
verses.literal: These women were from the nations about which the LORD had told . . . the Israelites . . . You must not intermarry with them - - for surely they will turn your hearts after their gods Yet Solomon clung to these women in love
verses.literalPt: Das nações de que o SENHOR tinha falado aos filhos de Israel: Não chegareis a elas, e elas não chegarão a vós; de outra maneira perverterão o vosso coração para seguirdes os seus deuses. A estas se uniu Salomão com amor.

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֣וֹ נָשִׁ֗ים שָׂרוֹת֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּפִֽלַגְשִׁ֖ים שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וַיַּטּ֥וּ נָשָׁ֖יו אֶת־ לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw nā·šîm śā·rō·wṯ šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ū·p̄i·laḡ·šîm šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ way·yaṭ·ṭū nā·šāw ’eṯ- lib·bōw
verses.literal: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines and his wives turned his heart away
verses.literalPt: E tinha setecentas mulheres, princesas, e trezentas concubinas; e suas mulheres lhe perverteram o coração.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י לְעֵת֙ זִקְנַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה נָשָׁיו֙ הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־ לְבָב֔וֹ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְלֹא־ הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו כִּלְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lə·‘êṯ ziq·naṯ šə·lō·mōh nā·šāw hiṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇōw ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·lō- hā·yāh lə·ḇā·ḇōw šā·lêm ‘im- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw kil·ḇaḇ dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: For when Solomon grew old his wives turned his heart after other gods and he was not wholeheartedly devoted to the LORD his God . . . as his father David had been
verses.literalPt: Porque sucedeu que, no tempo da velhice de Salomão, suas mulheres lhe perverteram o coração para seguir outros deuses; e o seu coração não era perfeito para com o SENHOR seu Deus, como o coração de Davi, seu pai,

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י עַשְׁתֹּ֔רֶת אֱלֹהֵ֖י צִדֹנִ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵ֣י מִלְכֹּ֔ם שִׁקֻּ֖ץ עַמֹּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ šə·lō·mōh ’a·ḥă·rê ‘aš·tō·reṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣi·ḏō·nîm wə·’a·ḥă·rê mil·kōm šiq·quṣ ‘am·mō·nîm
verses.literal: Solomon followed . . . Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians . . . and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites
verses.literalPt: Porque Salomão seguiu a Astarote, deusa dos sidônios, e Milcom, a abominação dos amonitas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א מִלֵּ֛א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּדָוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šə·lō·mōh hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh wə·lō mil·lê ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh kə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: So Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD unlike his father David he did not follow the LORD completely
verses.literalPt: Assim fez Salomão o que parecia mal aos olhos do SENHOR; e não perseverou em seguir ao SENHOR, como Davi, seu pai.

verses.original: אָז֩ יִבְנֶ֨ה שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בָּמָ֗ה לִכְמוֹשׁ֙ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ מוֹאָ֔ב בָּהָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּלְמֹ֕לֶךְ שִׁקֻּ֖ץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yiḇ·neh šə·lō·mōh bā·māh liḵ·mō·wōš šiq·quṣ mō·w·’āḇ bā·hār ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê yə·rū·šā·lim ū·lə·mō·leḵ šiq·quṣ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: At that time on a hill east of Jerusalem Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab and for Molech the abomination of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Então edificou Salomão um alto a Quemós, a abominação dos moabitas, sobre o monte que está diante de Jerusalém, e a Moloque, a abominação dos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וְכֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְכָל־ נָשָׁ֖יו הַנָּכְרִיּ֑וֹת מַקְטִיר֥וֹת וּֽמְזַבְּח֖וֹת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên ‘ā·śāh lə·ḵāl nā·šāw han·nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ maq·ṭî·rō·wṯ ū·mə·zab·bə·ḥō·wṯ lê·lō·hê·hen
verses.literal: He did the same for all his foreign wives who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods
verses.literalPt: E assim fez para com todas as suas mulheres estrangeiras; as quais queimavam incenso e sacrificavam a seus deuses.

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַנַּ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בִּשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה כִּֽי־ נָטָ֣ה לְבָב֗וֹ מֵעִ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו פַּעֲמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·’an·nap̄ Yah·weh biš·lō·mōh kî- nā·ṭāh lə·ḇā·ḇōw mê·‘im Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl han·nir·’āh ’ê·lāw pa·‘ă·mā·yim
verses.literal: Now the LORD grew angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the LORD the God of Israel who had appeared to him twice
verses.literalPt: Pelo que o SENHOR se indignou contra Salomão; porquanto desviara o seu coração do SENHOR Deus de Israel, o qual duas vezes lhe aparecera.

verses.original: וְצִוָּ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ עַל־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לְבִ֨לְתִּי־ לֶ֔כֶת אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ר אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiw·wāh ’ê·lāw ‘al- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lə·ḇil·tî- le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·lō šā·mar ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Although He had warned Solomon . . . explicitly . . . . . . not to follow . . . other gods Solomon did not keep - the LORD’s command
verses.literalPt: E acerca deste assunto lhe tinha dado ordem que não seguisse a outros deuses; porém não guardou o que o SENHOR lhe ordenara.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לִשְׁלֹמֹ֗ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיְתָה־ זֹּ֣את עִמָּ֔ךְ וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַ֙רְתָּ֙ בְּרִיתִ֣י וְחֻקֹּתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי עָלֶ֑יךָ קָרֹ֨עַ אֶקְרַ֤ע אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְעַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh liš·lō·mōh ya·‘an ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh- zōṯ ‘im·māḵ wə·lō šā·mar·tā bə·rî·ṯî wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯay ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ‘ā·le·ḵā qā·rō·a‘ ’eq·ra‘ ’eṯ- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh mê·‘ā·le·ḵā ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hā lə·‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Solomon Because you have done . . . this and have not kept My covenant and My statutes which I have commanded you I will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant
verses.literalPt: Assim disse o SENHOR a Salomão: Pois que houve isto em ti, que não guardaste a minha aliança e os meus estatutos que te mandei, certamente rasgarei de ti este reino, e o darei a teu servo.

verses.original: אַךְ־ בְּיָמֶ֙יךָ֙ לֹ֣א אֶעֱשֶׂ֔נָּה לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יךָ מִיַּ֥ד בִּנְךָ֖ אֶקְרָעֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- bə·yā·me·ḵā lō ’e·‘ĕ·śen·nāh lə·ma·‘an dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā mî·yaḏ bin·ḵā ’eq·rā·‘en·nāh
verses.literal: Nevertheless for the sake of your father David I will not do it during your lifetime I will tear it out of the hand of your son
verses.literalPt: Todavia nos teus dias não o farei, por amor de Davi, teu pai; da mão de teu filho o rasgarei;

verses.original: רַ֤ק אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ לֹ֣א אֶקְרָ֔ע שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָ֖ד אֶתֵּ֣ן לִבְנֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֙עַן֙ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י וּלְמַ֥עַן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: raq ’eṯ- kāl- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh lō ’eq·rā‘ šê·ḇeṭ ’e·ḥāḏ ’et·tên liḇ·ne·ḵā lə·ma·‘an dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî ū·lə·ma·‘an yə·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer bā·ḥā·rə·tî
verses.literal: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom away from him I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem which I have chosen
verses.literalPt: Porém todo o reino não rasgarei; uma tribo darei a teu filho, por amor de meu servo Davi, e por amor a Jerusalém, que tenho escolhido.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קֶם יְהוָ֤ה שָׂטָן֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֖ת הֲדַ֣ד הָאֲדֹמִ֑י מִזֶּ֧רַע הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ ה֖וּא בֶּאֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem Yah·weh śā·ṭān liš·lō·mōh ’êṯ hă·ḏaḏ hā·’ă·ḏō·mî miz·ze·ra‘ ham·me·leḵ hū be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary Hadad the Edomite - from the royal line of Edom
verses.literalPt: Levantou, pois, o SENHOR contra Salomão um adversário, Hadade, o edomeu; ele era da descendência do rei em Edom.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּֽהְי֤וֹת דָּוִד֙ אֶת־ אֱד֔וֹם בַּעֲל֗וֹת יוֹאָב֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א לְקַבֵּ֖ר אֶת־ הַחֲלָלִ֑ים וַיַּ֥ךְ כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר בֶּאֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bih·yō·wṯ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ba·‘ă·lō·wṯ yō·w·’āḇ śar haṣ·ṣā·ḇā lə·qab·bêr ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·lā·lîm way·yaḵ kāl- zā·ḵār be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Earlier when David was in Edom Joab the commander of the army had gone to bury the dead and had struck down every male in Edom
verses.literalPt: Porque sucedeu que, estando Davi em Edom, e subindo Joabe, o capitão do exército, a enterrar os mortos, feriu a todo o homem em Edom

verses.original: כִּ֣י שֵׁ֧שֶׁת חֳדָשִׁ֛ים יָֽשַׁב־ שָׁ֥ם יוֹאָ֖ב וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד־ הִכְרִ֥ית כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר בֶּאֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî šê·šeṯ ḥo·ḏā·šîm yā·šaḇ- šām yō·w·’āḇ wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- hiḵ·rîṯ kāl- zā·ḵār be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Joab and all Israel had stayed there six months until he had killed every male in Edom
verses.literalPt: (Porque Joabe ficou ali seis meses com todo o Israel, até que destruiu a todo o homem em Edom).

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֣ח אֲדַ֡ד הוּא֩ וַאֲנָשִׁ֨ים אֲדֹמִיִּ֜ים מֵעַבְדֵ֥י אָבִ֛יו אִתּ֖וֹ לָב֣וֹא מִצְרָ֑יִם וַהֲדַ֖ד נַ֥עַר קָטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·raḥ ’ă·ḏaḏ hū wa·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·ḏō·mî·yîm mê·‘aḇ·ḏê ’ā·ḇîw ’it·tōw lā·ḇō·w miṣ·rā·yim wa·hă·ḏaḏ na·‘ar qā·ṭān
verses.literal: But Hadad . . . still just a young boy had fled to Egypt . . . along with . . . some Edomites who were servants of his father
verses.literalPt: Hadade, porém, fugiu, ele e alguns homens edomeus, dos servos de seu pai, com ele, para ir ao Egito; era, porém, Hadade muito jovem.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֙מוּ֙ מִמִּדְיָ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ פָּארָ֑ן וַיִּקְחוּ֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים עִמָּ֜ם מִפָּארָ֗ן וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ בַ֗יִת וְלֶ֙חֶם֙ אָ֣מַר ל֔וֹ וְאֶ֖רֶץ נָ֥תַן לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū mim·miḏ·yān way·yā·ḇō·’ū pā·rān way·yiq·ḥū ’ă·nā·šîm ‘im·mām mip·pā·rān way·yā·ḇō·’ū miṣ·ra·yim ’el- par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim way·yit·ten- lōw ḇa·yiṯ wə·le·ḥem ’ā·mar lōw wə·’e·reṣ nā·ṯan lōw
verses.literal: Hadad and his men set out from Midian and went to Paran They took men from Paran with them and went to Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt who gave Hadad a house - and land and provided him with food
verses.literalPt: E levantaram-se de Midiã, e foram a Parã, e tomaram consigo homens de Parã, e foram ao Egito ter com Faraó, rei do Egito, o qual lhe deu uma casa, e lhe prometeu sustento, e lhe deu uma terra.

verses.original: וַיִּמְצָא֙ הֲדַ֥ד חֵ֛ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֤וֹ אִשָּׁה֙ אֶת־ אֲח֣וֹת אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ אֲח֖וֹת תַּחְפְּנֵ֥יס הַגְּבִירָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·ṣā hă·ḏaḏ ḥên bə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh mə·’ōḏ way·yit·ten- lōw ’iš·šāh ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·wṯ ’iš·tōw ’ă·ḥō·wṯ taḥ·pə·nês hag·gə·ḇî·rāh
verses.literal: There Hadad found such great favor in the sight of Pharaoh that he gave to him in marriage the sister . . . of Queen Tahpenes his own wife
verses.literalPt: E achou Hadade grande graça diante de Faraó, de maneira que lhe deu por mulher a irmã de sua mulher, a irmã de Tafnes, a rainha.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨לֶד ל֜וֹ אֲח֣וֹת תַּחְפְּנֵ֗יס אֵ֚ת גְּנֻבַ֣ת בְּנ֔וֹ וַתִּגְמְלֵ֣הוּ תַחְפְּנֵ֔ס בְּת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֣ית פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י גְנֻבַת֙ בֵּ֣ית פַּרְעֹ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ lōw ’ă·ḥō·wṯ taḥ·pə·nês ’êṯ gə·nu·ḇaṯ bə·nōw wat·tiḡ·mə·lê·hū ṯaḥ·pə·nês bə·ṯō·wḵ bêṯ par·‘ōh way·hî ḡə·nu·ḇaṯ bêṯ par·‘ōh bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: And the sister of Tahpenes bore Hadad a son named Genubath Tahpenes herself weaned him in Pharaoh’s palace and Genubath lived there . . . among the sons of Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: E a irmã de Tafnes deu-lhe um filho, Genubate, o qual Tafnes criou na casa de Faraó; e Genubate estava na casa de Faraó, entre os filhos de Faraó.

verses.original: וַהֲדַ֞ד שָׁמַ֣ע בְּמִצְרַ֗יִם כִּֽי־ שָׁכַ֤ב דָּוִד֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וְכִי־ מֵ֖ת יוֹאָ֣ב שַֽׂר־ הַצָּבָ֑א וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הֲדַד֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה שַׁלְּחֵ֖נִי וְאֵלֵ֥ךְ אֶל־ אַרְצִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḏaḏ šā·ma‘ bə·miṣ·ra·yim kî- šā·ḵaḇ dā·wiḏ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw wə·ḵî- mêṯ yō·w·’āḇ śar- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā way·yō·mer hă·ḏaḏ ’el- par·‘ōh šal·lə·ḥê·nî wə·’ê·lêḵ ’el- ’ar·ṣî
verses.literal: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David had rested with his fathers and that Joab the commander of the army was dead he said to Pharaoh Let me go that I may return to my own country
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, Hadade, no Egito, que Davi adormecera com seus pais, e que Joabe, capitão do exército, era morto, disse Hadade a Faraó: Despede-me, para que vá à minha terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ פַרְעֹ֗ה כִּ֠י מָה־ אַתָּ֤ה חָסֵר֙ עִמִּ֔י וְהִנְּךָ֥ מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לָלֶ֣כֶת אֶל־ אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לֹ֔א כִּ֥י שַׁלֵּ֖חַ תְּשַׁלְּחֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw p̄ar·‘ōh kî māh- ’at·tāh ḥā·sêr ‘im·mî wə·hin·nə·ḵā mə·ḇaq·qêš lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- ’ar·ṣe·ḵā way·yō·mer lō kî šal·lê·aḥ tə·šal·lə·ḥê·nî
verses.literal: But Pharaoh asked him What have you lacked here with me that you suddenly want to go back to your own country Nothing Hadad replied but please let me go . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém Faraó lhe disse: Pois que te falta comigo, que procuras partir para a tua terra? E disse ele: Nada, mas todavia despede-me.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קֶם אֱלֹהִ֥ים לוֹ֙ שָׂטָ֔ן אֶת־ רְז֖וֹן בֶּן־ אֶלְיָדָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרַ֗ח מֵאֵ֛ת הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ צוֹבָ֖ה אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ’ĕ·lō·hîm lōw śā·ṭān ’eṯ- rə·zō·wn ben- ’el·yā·ḏā‘ ’ă·šer bā·raḥ mê·’êṯ hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer me·leḵ- ṣō·w·ḇāh ’ă·ḏō·nāw
verses.literal: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary Rezon the son of Eliada who had fled from his master Hadadezer king of Zobah
verses.literalPt: Também Deus lhe levantou outro adversário, a Rezom, filho de Eliada, que tinha fugido de seu SENHOR Hadadezer, rei de Zoba,

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ עָלָיו֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י שַׂר־ גְּד֔וּד בַּהֲרֹ֥ג דָּוִ֖ד אֹתָ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֤וּ דַמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וַֽיִּמְלְכ֖וּ בְּדַמָּֽשֶׂק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōṣ ‘ā·lāw ’ă·nā·šîm way·hî śar- gə·ḏūḏ ba·hă·rōḡ dā·wiḏ ’ō·ṯām way·yê·lə·ḵū ḏam·me·śeq way·yê·šə·ḇū ḇāh way·yim·lə·ḵū bə·ḏam·mā·śeq
verses.literal: and had gathered men to himself When David killed the Zobaites Rezon captained . . . a band of raiders and went to Damascus where they settled and gained control
verses.literalPt: Contra quem também ajuntou homens, e foi capitão de um esquadrão, quando Davi os matou; e, indo-se para Damasco, habitaram ali, e reinaram em Damasco.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י שָׂטָ֤ן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֶת־ הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲדָ֑ד וַיָּ֙קָץ֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל־ אֲרָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî śā·ṭān lə·yiś·rā·’êl kāl- yə·mê šə·lō·mōh wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer hă·ḏāḏ way·yā·qāṣ bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·lōḵ ‘al- ’ă·rām
verses.literal: Rezon was Israel’s enemy throughout the days of Solomon adding to the trouble caused by Hadad So Rezon ruled over Aram with hostility toward Israel
verses.literalPt: E foi adversário de Israel, por todos os dias de Salomão, e isto além do mal que Hadade fazia; porque detestava a Israel, e reinava sobre a Síria.

verses.original: וְיָרָבְעָם֩ בֶּן־ נְבָ֨ט אֶפְרָתִ֜י מִן־ הַצְּרֵדָ֗ה וְשֵׁ֤ם אִמּוֹ֙ צְרוּעָה֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה עֶ֖בֶד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיָּ֥רֶם יָ֖ד בַּמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ep̄·rā·ṯî min- haṣ·ṣə·rê·ḏāh wə·šêm ’im·mōw ṣə·rū·‘āh ’iš·šāh ’al·mā·nāh ‘e·ḇeḏ liš·lō·mōh way·yā·rem yāḏ bam·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Now Jeroboam son of Nebat was an Ephraimite from Zeredah whose mother . . . was a widow named Zeruah Jeroboam was a servant of Solomon but he rebelled . . . against the king
verses.literalPt: Até Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, efrateu, de Zereda, servo de Salomão (cuja mãe era mulher viúva, por nome Zerua), também levantou a mão contra o rei.

verses.original: וְזֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־ הֵרִ֥ים יָ֖ד בַּמֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־ הַמִּלּ֔וֹא סָגַ֕ר אֶת־ פֶּ֕רֶץ עִ֖יר דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- hê·rîm yāḏ bam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bā·nāh ’eṯ- ham·mil·lō·w sā·ḡar ’eṯ- pe·reṣ ‘îr dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: and this is the account of his rebellion . . . against the king Solomon had built the supporting terraces and repaired the gap in the wall of the city of his father David
verses.literalPt: E esta foi a causa por que levantou a mão contra o rei: Salomão tinha edificado a Milo, e cerrou as aberturas da cidade de Davi, seu pai.

verses.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ יָרָבְעָ֖ם גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וַיַּ֨רְא שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ הַנַּ֗עַר כִּֽי־ עֹשֵׂ֤ה מְלָאכָה֙ ה֔וּא וַיַּפְקֵ֣ד אֹת֔וֹ לְכָל־ סֵ֖בֶל בֵּ֥ית יוֹסֵֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām gib·bō·wr ḥā·yil way·yar šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- han·na·‘ar kî- ‘ō·śêh mə·lā·ḵāh hū way·yap̄·qêḏ ’ō·ṯōw lə·ḵāl sê·ḇel bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: Now Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor So when Solomon noticed that the young man was industrious . . . he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the house of Joseph
verses.literalPt: E o homem Jeroboão era forte e valente; e vendo Salomão a este jovem, que era laborioso, ele o pôs sobre todo o cargo da casa de José.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא וְיָֽרָבְעָ֖ם יָצָ֣א מִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּמְצָ֣א אֹת֡וֹ אֲחִיָּה֩ הַשִּׁילֹנִ֨י הַנָּבִ֜יא בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ וְה֤וּא מִתְכַּסֶּה֙ בְּשַׂלְמָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֥ם לְבַדָּ֖ם בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bā·‘êṯ ha·hî wə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām yā·ṣā mî·rū·šā·lim way·yim·ṣā ’ō·ṯōw ’ă·ḥî·yāh haš·šî·lō·nî han·nā·ḇî bad·de·reḵ wə·hū miṯ·kas·seh bə·śal·māh ḥă·ḏā·šāh ū·šə·nê·hem lə·ḇad·dām baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: During that time the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met Jeroboam on the road as he was going out of Jerusalem Now Ahijah had wrapped himself in a new cloak and the two of them were alone in the open field
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, naquele tempo que, saindo Jeroboão de Jerusalém, o profeta Aías, o silonita, o encontrou no caminho, e ele estava vestido com uma roupa nova, e os dois estavam sós no campo.

verses.original: וַיִּתְפֹּ֣שׂ אֲחִיָּ֔ה בַּשַּׂלְמָ֥ה הַחֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וַיִּ֨קְרָעֶ֔הָ שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר קְרָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pōś ’ă·ḥî·yāh baś·śal·māh ha·ḥă·ḏā·šāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw way·yiq·rā·‘e·hā šə·nêm ‘ā·śār qə·rā·‘îm
verses.literal: And Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing tore it into twelve . . . pieces
verses.literalPt: E Aías pegou na roupa nova que tinha sobre si, e a rasgou em doze pedaços.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְיָֽרָבְעָ֔ם קַח־ לְךָ֖ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה קְרָעִ֑ים כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֨י קֹרֵ֤עַ אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ מִיַּ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְךָ֔ אֵ֖ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַשְּׁבָטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām qaḥ- lə·ḵā ‘ă·śā·rāh qə·rā·‘îm kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî qō·rê·a‘ ’eṯ- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh mî·yaḏ šə·lō·mōh wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’êṯ ‘ă·śā·rāh haš·šə·ḇā·ṭîm
verses.literal: and said to Jeroboam Take ten pieces for yourself for this is what the LORD the God of Israel says Behold I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and I will give you ten tribes
verses.literalPt: E disse a Jeroboão: Toma para ti os dez pedaços, porque assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Eis que rasgarei o reino da mão de Salomão, e a ti darei as dez tribos.

verses.original: וְהַשֵּׁ֥בֶט הָאֶחָ֖ד יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֑וֹ לְמַ֣עַן׀ עַבְדִּ֣י דָוִ֗ד וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי בָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šê·ḇeṭ hā·’e·ḥāḏ yih·yeh- lōw lə·ma·‘an ‘aḇ·dî ḏā·wiḏ ū·lə·ma·‘an yə·rū·šā·lim hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tî ḇāh mik·kōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But one tribe will remain for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem the city I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porém ele terá uma tribo, por amor de Davi, meu servo, e por amor de Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֮ לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צִֽדֹנִין֒ לִכְמוֹשׁ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וּלְמִלְכֹּ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֑וֹן וְלֹֽא־ הָלְכ֣וּ בִדְרָכַ֗י לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת הַיָּשָׁ֧ר בְּעֵינַ֛י וְחֻקֹּתַ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י כְּדָוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·‘aš·tō·reṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣi·ḏō·nîn liḵ·mō·wōš ’ĕ·lō·hê mō·w·’āḇ ū·lə·mil·kōm ’ĕ·lō·hê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wə·lō- hā·lə·ḵū ḇiḏ·rā·ḵay la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nay wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯay ū·miš·pā·ṭay kə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: For they have forsaken Me to worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians Chemosh the god of the Moabites and Milcom the god of the Ammonites . . . They have not walked in My ways nor done what is right in My eyes nor kept My statutes and judgments as Solomon’s father David did
verses.literalPt: Porque me deixaram, e se encurvaram a Astarote, deusa dos sidônios, a Quemós, deus dos moabitas, e a Milcom, deus dos filhos de Amom; e não andaram pelos meus caminhos, para fazerem o que é reto aos meus olhos, a saber, os meus estatutos e os meus juízos, como Davi, seu pai.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אֶקַּ֥ח אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה מִיָּד֑וֹ כִּ֣י׀ נָשִׂ֣יא אֲשִׁתֶ֗נּוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו לְמַ֨עַן דָּוִ֤ד עַבְדִּי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי אֹת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֥י וְחֻקֹּתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- kāl- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh mî·yā·ḏōw kî nā·śî ’ă·ši·ṯen·nū kōl yə·mê ḥay·yāw lə·ma·‘an dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tî ’ō·ṯōw ’ă·šer šā·mar miṣ·wō·ṯay wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāy
verses.literal: Nevertheless, I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand because I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David My servant whom I chose because he kept My commandments and statutes
verses.literalPt: Porém não tomarei nada deste reino da sua mão; mas por príncipe o ponho por todos os dias da sua vida, por amor de Davi, meu servo, a quem escolhi, o qual guardou os meus mandamentos e os meus estatutos.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֥י הַמְּלוּכָ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד בְּנ֑וֹ וּנְתַתִּ֣יהָ לְּךָ֔ אֵ֖ת עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַשְּׁבָטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ham·mə·lū·ḵāh mî·yaḏ bə·nōw ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hā lə·ḵā ’êṯ ‘ă·śe·reṯ haš·šə·ḇā·ṭîm
verses.literal: But I will take ten tribes of the kingdom from the hand of his son and give them to you
verses.literalPt: Mas da mão de seu filho tomarei o reino, e darei a ti, as dez tribos dele.

verses.original: וְלִבְנ֖וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן שֵֽׁבֶט־ אֶחָ֑ד לְמַ֣עַן הֱיֽוֹת־ נִ֣יר לְדָֽוִיד־ עַ֠בְדִּי כָּֽל־ הַיָּמִ֤ים׀ לְפָנַי֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔י לָשׂ֥וּם שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nōw ’et·tên šê·ḇeṭ- ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ma·‘an hĕ·yō·wṯ- nîr lə·ḏā·wîḏ- ‘aḇ·dî kāl- hay·yā·mîm lə·p̄ā·nay bî·rū·šā·lim hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tî lî lā·śūm šə·mî šām
verses.literal: I will give one tribe to his son so that My servant David will always . . . have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem the city where I chose to put My Name
verses.literalPt: E a seu filho darei uma tribo; para que Davi, meu servo, sempre tenha uma lâmpada diante de mim em Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi para pôr ali o meu nome.

verses.original: וְאֹתְךָ֣ אֶקַּ֔ח וּמָ֣לַכְתָּ֔ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·ṯə·ḵā ’eq·qaḥ ū·mā·laḵ·tā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tə·’aw·weh nap̄·še·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But as for you I will take you and you shall reign over all that your heart desires and you will be king over Israel
verses.literalPt: E te tomarei, e reinarás sobre tudo o que desejar a tua alma; e serás rei sobre Israel.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ תִּשְׁמַע֮ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּךָ֒ וְהָלַכְתָּ֣ בִדְרָכַ֗י וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ הַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינַי֙ לִשְׁמ֤וֹר חֻקּוֹתַי֙ וּמִצְוֺתַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י וְהָיִ֣יתִי עִמָּ֗ךְ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְךָ֤ בַֽיִת־ נֶאֱמָן֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנִ֣יתִי לְדָוִ֔ד וְנָתַתִּ֥י לְךָ֖ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- tiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·we·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tā ḇiḏ·rā·ḵay wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nay liš·mō·wr ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî wə·hā·yî·ṯî ‘im·māḵ ū·ḇā·nî·ṯî lə·ḵā ḇa·yiṯ- ne·’ĕ·mān ka·’ă·šer bā·nî·ṯî lə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: If you listen to all that I command you walk in My ways and do what is right in My sight in order to keep My statutes and commandments as My servant David did then I will be with you I will build you a lasting dynasty just as I built for David and I will give Israel to you
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que, se ouvires tudo o que eu te mandar, e andares pelos meus caminhos, e fizeres o que é reto aos meus olhos, guardando os meus estatutos e os meus mandamentos, como fez Davi, meu servo, eu serei contigo, e te edificarei uma casa firme, como edifiquei a Davi, e te darei Israel.

verses.original: וַֽאעַנֶּ֛ה אֶת־ זֶ֥רַע דָּוִ֖ד לְמַ֣עַן זֹ֑את אַ֖ךְ לֹ֥א כָל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·‘an·neh ’eṯ- ze·ra‘ dā·wiḏ lə·ma·‘an zōṯ ’aḵ lō ḵāl hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Because of this I will humble David’s descendants but not forever . . .
verses.literalPt: E por isso afligirei a descendência de Davi; todavia não para sempre.

verses.original: וַיְבַקֵּ֥שׁ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְהָמִ֣ית אֶת־ יָרָבְעָ֑ם וַיָּ֣קָם יָרָבְעָ֗ם וַיִּבְרַ֤ח מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־ שִׁישַׁ֣ק מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיְהִ֥י בְמִצְרַ֖יִם עַד־ מ֥וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇaq·qêš šə·lō·mōh lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām way·yā·qām yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām way·yiḇ·raḥ miṣ·ra·yim ’el- šî·šaq me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim way·hî ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: Solomon therefore sought to kill Jeroboam But Jeroboam arose and fled to Egypt to Shishak king of Egypt where he remained until the death of Solomon
verses.literalPt: Assim Salomão procurou matar Jeroboão; porém Jeroboão se levantou, e fugiu para o Egito, a ter com Sisaque, rei do Egito; e esteve no Egito até que Salomão morreu.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְחָכְמָת֑וֹ הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתֻבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê šə·lō·mōh wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯōw hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯu·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon all that he did as well as his wisdom are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Salomão, e a tudo quanto fez, e à sua sabedoria, porventura não está escrito no livro dos feitos de Salomão?

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ מָלַ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer mā·laḵ šə·lō·mōh ḇî·rū·šā·lim ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Thus the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years
verses.literalPt: E o tempo que reinou Salomão, em Jerusalém, sobre todo o Israel foi quarenta anos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁלֹמֹה֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּ֨קָּבֵ֔ר בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ רְחַבְעָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ šə·lō·mōh ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw way·yim·lōḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E adormeceu Salomão com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi, seu pai; e Roboão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
